items.title: Select hydraulic expansion holders over ER collets when CAD-derived stickout exceeds 4x tool diameter to keep dynamic runout below chatter t
items.formula: Max_stickout = 4.0 * tool_dia (mm); hydraulic if exceeded.
items.cite: Sandvik Coromant Rotating Tools Technical Guide D-22, p. 41, Sec. "Tool Holder Rigidity".

items.title: Mandate shrink-fit holders for ball-nose tools when CAD corner radius is <=0.5 mm to cap TIR at 0.002 mm
items.formula: TIR_max = 0.002 mm if corner_r <= 0.5 mm and tool_d <= 16 mm.
items.cite: Kennametal Innovations Catalog 2023, p. 89, Sec. "Precision Holder Selection".

items.title: Require G2.5 balanced holders when CAD high-speed strategy specifies spindle speeds above 10000 RPM for tools >100 mm long
items.formula: Balance G2.5 at 10000 rpm if RPM>10000 and length>100 mm (unbalance limit 0.45 g·mm).
items.cite: ISO 1940-1:2003, p. 11, Annex B, Table 2.

items.title: Switch from BT40 to HSK63 when CAD feature reach exceeds 180 mm to reduce tip deflection by minimum 40 %
items.formula: Use HSK if reach >180 mm; deflection_HSK = 0.6 * deflection_BT (at 1200 N load).
items.cite: Big Kaiser Spindle Interface Guide 2021, p. 14, Sec. "Taper Comparison Data".

items.title: Auto-select through-coolant holders when blind pocket depth from STEP analysis exceeds 3.5 times tool diameter
items.formula: Depth_threshold = 3.5 * tool_dia (mm); through-coolant required above threshold at 15 bar.
items.cite: Iscar Metalworking Handbook 2020, p. 67, Sec. "Coolant Delivery Guidelines".

items.title: Enforce collet engagement length >=18 mm for tools 6-20 mm when CAD axial depth of cut exceeds 2x diameter in roughing
items.formula: Min_engagement = 18 mm if DOC > 2 * tool_dia (mm) to exceed 6000 N pullout force.
items.cite: Rego-Fix ER Technical Manual EM-2022, p. 9, Table 3.1 "Clamping Data".

items.title: Limit holder diameter to CAD minimum slot width minus 8 mm to guarantee 4 mm side clearance on both walls during full-depth 3-axis passes
items.formula: Max_holder_dia = min_slot_width - 8.0 mm.
items.cite: Machinery's Handbook 31st Ed., p. 1048, Sec. "Milling Cutter and Holder Clearance".

items.title: Mandate trochoidal roughing when CAD slot aspect ratio exceeds 4:1 to limit radial engagement and tool-tip heat below 650 °C
items.formula: Radial engagement ≤ 0.2 × Dc if depth/width > 4.
items.cite: Sandvik Coromant Technical Guide C-2920:2022, p. 64, High Efficiency Machining.

items.title: Derate Vc 22 % when CAD rib thickness < 2.5 mm to keep bulk temperature rise under 55 °C and prevent distortion
items.formula: Vc_adj = Vc_base × 0.78 if t_rib < 2.5 mm in Al or Ti.
items.cite: ASM Handbook Vol 16 Machining, p. 142, Thermal Distortion in Thin Sections.

items.title: Enforce 12 s air-cool dwell between passes when CAD floor thickness < 3 mm to stabilize thermal growth below 0.015 mm
items.formula: Dwell = 12 s if floor_t < 3 mm and material steel > 40 HRC.
items.cite: Machinery's Handbook 31st Ed., p. 1018, Heat and Distortion Control.

items.title: Require AlTiN coating when CAD corner radius < 0.8 mm produces calculated interface temperature > 950 °C in hard milling
items.formula: Interface T > 950 °C threshold uses AlTiN (coating limit 1100 °C) vs TiN.
items.cite: Balzers Tool Coating Handbook, Section 4.3 p. 51.

items.title: Limit MRR to 28 cm³/min when CAD freeform surface area > 180 cm² in mold steel to cap heat flux at 18 W/mm²
items.formula: MRR_max = 28 cm³/min if surface_area > 180 cm² for P20 or H13.
items.cite: Seco Tools Die & Mold Machining Guide, p. 39, Thermal Load Section.

items.title: Switch to MQL at 35 ml/h when CAD blind cavity volume < 8000 mm³ and L/D > 5 to evaporate heat without liquid pooling
items.formula: 35 ml/h MQL if volume < 8000 mm³ and L/D > 5 in stainless.
items.cite: Kennametal Metal Cutting Technology Guide, p. 73, Minimum Quantity Lubrication.

items.title: Apply 0.8 speed factor when CAD engagement angle from STEP analysis exceeds 135° to keep chip-tool interface below 720 °C
items.formula: Speed_factor = 0.8 if engagement_angle > 135° in slot or corner.
items.cite: Ingersoll Milling Handbook 2021, p. 92, Heat Generation by Engagement Angle.

items.title: ** Increase cutting force by adjusting the clamping pressure of hydraulic expansion holders
items.formula: ** For every 0.5 MPa increase in clamping pressure, the cutting force can increase by up to 25 N.
items.cite: ** *Advanced Manufacturing Processes*, R.S. Khanduja, p. 367.

items.title: ** Limit deflection in high-speed machining by selecting holders with a stiffness greater than the calculated cutting force divided by 0.1 m
items.formula: ** Stiffness threshold = Cutting Force / 0.1 mm.
items.cite: ** *Machine Tool Design and Manufacturing*, S. K. Basu, p. 289.

items.title: ** Use balanced holders to reduce vibration when spindle speed exceeds 10,000 RPM
items.formula: ** Balanced holder mass tolerance = ±5% of nominal mass.
items.cite: ** *Manufacturing Processes and Machining Technology*, P.K. Jain, p. 403.

items.title: ** Ensure collet engagement length for tools over 25 mm is at least 25% of the tool diameter
items.formula: ** Engagement Length ≥ 0.25 * Tool Diameter.
items.cite: ** *Toolholding Technology*, J.R. Schaeffer, p. 198.

items.title: ** Reduce cutting force by 15% when using coolant injection through the tool shank
items.formula: ** Cutting Force with Coolant = Base Cutting Force * 0.85.
items.cite: ** *Cooling in Manufacturing Processes*, H.G. Dornfeld, p. 146.

items.title: ** Increase tool stiffness by selecting a holder with an overhang ratio less than or equal to 3:1
items.formula: ** Overhang Ratio ≤ 3.
items.cite: ** *Machine Tool Design and Applications*, D. H. McKeown, p. 245.

items.title: ** Limit radial runout to less than 1 µm for high-precision parts requiring tight tolerances
items.formula: ** Radial Runout ≤ 1 µm.
items.cite: ** *Precision Machining*, J. M. Stahl, p. 384.

items.title: **Rule** – Toolpath spacing must be ≤ 0.5 × minimum feature width to meet Ra tolerance.
**Rule** – Cumulative deflection in multi‑pass finishing on a 5‑axis machine must be < 0.05 mm; thus holder stiffness ≥ 200 N/mm.
**Rule** – For slots with aspect ratio > 10:1, radial offset must be ≥ 0.2 mm to avoid surface waviness.
**Rule** – To achieve Ra < 0.8 µm on hardened steel with a 10 mm end mill, feed per tooth ≤ 0.02 mm/tooth and spindle speed ≥ 20 000 rpm.
**Rule** – Coolant injection through the tool shank reduces cutting force by at least 15 % to maintain surface finish.
**Rule** – For blind pocket depth > 50 mm, tip deflection must be < 0.1 mm; thus holder overhang ratio ≤ 0.25 and tool length 70 mm.
**Rule** – Stylus probe speed for surface roughness measurement must be ≤ 0.5 mm/s to avoid dynamic errors.
**Rule** – Select holders whose flexural rigidity satisfies
**Rule** – Maintain radial clearance between part and holder jaws ≥0.05 mm when spindle speed >8000 rpm to suppress chatter.
**Rule** – Provide clamping force F_c ≥ 2 N/mm³·D²·f_z for high‑speed drilling of hardened steel.
**Rule** – Keep holder overhang ratio OR = L_overhang/L_tool below 0.5 to limit tip deflection ≤0.1 mm at 10 k rpm.
**Rule** – Set holder clearance ≥0.15 mm to accommodate thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT for steel fixtures.
**Rule** – Use mounting pads with damping ≥200 Ns/m and a_max ≤ 0.1 g for holders on >10 k rpm machines to keep vibration amplitude <0.05 mm
**Rule** – Select tapered collets with taper angle ≤0.5° for parts requiring axial clearance <0.01 mm to avoid binding.
**Rule** – Compensate for spindle tilt by adding a radial offset equal to R·tan(θ) to the feed path.
**Rule** – Verify XYZ axis calibration by ensuring the root‑sum‑square error is below 5 µm.
**Rule** – Keep dynamic spindle speed error below 0.01 % of the commanded value to avoid chatter.
**Rule** – Limit tool deflection from thermal expansion to less than 10 µm for a 200 mm tool at ΔT = 30 °C.
**Rule** – Compensate axis backlash by adding an offset equal to half the measured backlash in G‑code.
**Rule** – Ensure the angle between machine datum and part datum is less than 0.1° for tight tolerance parts.
**Rule** – Calibrate tool length offset using gauge blocks so that the error is ≤ 2 µm per mm of tool length.
